dispute_ticket.description: I was quoted S$19.40 but charged S$24.30. The driver went a completely different way to Bishan, we reached my brunch 4 minutes late and I was upset. I want the S$4.90 route charge refunded.

trip_data.driver_reported_reason: Avoiding jam on the usual expressway

chat_logs.content: Why are we going east? Bishan is south.

app_events.details: Rider R-7116 booked RydeX trip RYDE-DS-016 at upfront fare S$19.40 (14.0 km, 22 min).
Vehicle left the recommended route. No LTA road closure, accident or traffic alert recorded for the recommended route in the period 09:30-10:45.
Trip completed. Distance 18.9 km (+4.9 km versus the 14.0 km quote).
Automatic route adjustment 4.9 km x S$1.00 = S$4.90 added; final fare S$24.30.
The in-app rating screen failed to load for about 5 minutes after the trip.

fare_basis.value: fixed upfront for the pickup/drop-off pair; extra distance billed at the extra-distance rate
fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

extra_distance_rate_per_km.text: The rate in SGD per km applied to any extra distance that is billable on this trip.

detour_for_verified_road_closure_billabl.text: Governs extra distance caused by a road closure. A true value means the rider may be billed for it only when the closure is verified.

driver_chosen_route_changes_fixed_fare.text: Governs whether a route the driver chooses for their own reasons changes a fixed upfront fare. A false value means it does not.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The fare was fixed upfront at S$19.40 and the driver left the recommended route at 10:07:30. The app found no road closure, accident or traffic alert on the recommended route in the period, and the driver's own reason was a 'jam'. Under this trip's policy extra distance is billable only for a verified closure, and a driver-chosen route does not change a fixed fare, so the automatic route adjustment of 4.9 km x S$1.00 = S$4.90 must be refunded. The 4-minute lateness and the rider's upset do not affect the amount.
